now.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
now.text: Johnny Storm, carrying all four powers, knocks him off the board into the sea.
cases: PR-013 The Coming of Galactus (Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer)

proposed.text: Johnny Storm, carrying all four powers, breaks his hold on the board, and Ben knocks him into the sea with a crane.

changes.evidence: In Shanghai, Johnny (with the team's combined powers) breaks Doom's control over the board, but it is Ben who knocks Doom off the board and into the harbor with a demolition crane, where he sinks. The record credits Johnny with knocking him into the sea.

now.title: Blade: Trinity
now.text: At the vampires' blood farm, Blade shoots Vreede for rounding up humans for them.
cases: PR-006 The Release of Daystar (Blade: Trinity)

changes.evidence: Blade shoots Vreede at the blood farm (the storehouse of comatose humans), well before the final assault where Blade stabs Drake and the Daystar virus is released. 'The Release of Daystar' is not about this event.

now.title: Blade: Trinity
now.text: Danica Talos awakens Dracula in the Syrian desert and frames Blade for killing a human.
cases: PR-006 The Release of Daystar (Blade: Trinity)

changes.evidence: This record covers waking Drake in the Syrian Desert and framing Blade at the start of the film. The Daystar release comes at the climax and is already attached to her k=1 record (her death by the virus).

now.title: Blade: Trinity
now.text: Sommerfield builds the Daystar virus, but the vampires kill her when they raid the Nightstalkers.
cases: PR-006 The Release of Daystar (Blade: Trinity)

changes.evidence: Sommerfield's record ends with her death in the raid on the Nightstalkers' hideout. Daystar is released only later, when Blade stabs Drake with the arrow in the final assault, after she is dead, so the record ends before the event that case covers.
